_note: Shot types and scenes for the dashboard. Text is style-neutral: fit, shoulder, pockets and zip come from catalogue/ through the compiler, never from here. Keep every compiled prompt at 120-190 words before prompt rules, so rules a person switches on fit inside CLAUDE.md's 220 (tests/test_specs.py checks every combination; switching a rule on checks the longest prompt in its scope). On-model recipes take background and lighting from the chosen scene; packshots ignore the scene. requires_decoration: the shot has nothing to show without a design. pipeline/specs.py adds the catalogue's "<shoulder> shoulder seams" to must_show (in place of a generic "the shoulder seams") unless shows_shoulders is false: a framing that leaves the shoulders out.
